我是KyrieT331，我负责 FR-02 财务指标校验，计划和测试设计由 EverForests 评审，目前还没审批。这是正式仓库的第一轮，只请你读材料、复述你理解的范围，等我核对后再写计划。请先读 AGENTS.md 和 Prompt.md，再按里面的顺序读 D1–D4，同时核对 docs/README.md、docs/review-memo.md 里与 FR-02 有关的条目和 docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md。约定是 v1.0，重点看 C0 和 C2。不要生成代码、写测试、改文件或运行命令。

共同基线和我分支的 HEAD 都是 3d5ce620e7da497e09c986ef6cbc957b490de632。环境是 Python 3.11.17、TradingAgents 0.7.1、OpenCode 2.3.0。只做离线验收。完整中文会话由我保存在个人记录里。上游测试已经在前一版跑过，本次改的是读取权限。正式功能测试还没写。

四个案例的数据已经整理在我的来源表里，表的 SHA-256 是 25d0d76300b68c372443d9624e8bd83ac0a6a2d38d58cd17ab8ea797e2da63ae。这个哈希标记来源表的版本，正式测试样本还没冻结和审批。NVDA 两个可比季度的营收是 46743、96221 百万美元，用的是留存的 SEC 缓存，没有当次逐工具回包。AAPL 两个完整财年的 Cost of Revenue 是 220960、245232 百万美元。MSFT 2026 财年的资本开支和经营现金流是 115948、182935 百万美元。AAPL 在 2026-11-10 的上轨是 352.771 美元，收盘是 348.245 美元。苹果和微软的当次工具输出我有单独归档，你不用读仓库外的文件。请把个人留存、仓库里能查到的来源，以及 D4 的合成对照分别说明；仓库证据不全的如实写，不能算已通过。

请对照 T-FR02-YOY、T-FR02-RATIO、T-FR02-DELTA、T-FR02-INVALID、T-FR02-IDENTITY，复述四个目标值、正反价差、容差、异常输入，以及下游字段和最终表如何引用同一条指标记录。可先把 tradingagents/agents/verified_metrics.py（拟新增）、tradingagents/agents/analysts/fundamentals_analyst.py、tradingagents/agents/state.py、tradingagents/reporting.py 和 test/offline/test_verified_metrics.py（拟新增）当作候选；这一轮没有批准任何编辑。列出你还需要确认的具体路径、共享接口或来源。缺读取权限的话，写清文件和原因就停下。先别展开实施计划或测试设计，复述完等我确认。

1: # CS5351 agent entry point
2: 
3: Build target: extend the existing single-stock TradingAgents application for FR-01–FR-03 and NFR-01–NFR-02. The unchanged reference is `upstream-baseline` at `9fa1196fffbcfd9de5146d2dd2869df84ab99838`. Preserve `tradingagents/`, `cli/` and the existing test suite; add course tests under `test/offline/` and `test/live/`.
4: 
5: Documentation: [index](docs/README.md), [C0–C5 contracts](docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md) and [review records](docs/review-memo.md). Use the approved specification revision. Report missing allowlist paths to the human maintainer before the affected operation.
6: 
7: Read in order: [D1 registry](docs/req/requirements.yaml), [blueprint](architecture-blueprint.md), [ADR](docs/architecture/adr/001-choice-tbd.md), [invariants](docs/architecture/invariants.md), [trace matrix](docs/architecture/trace-matrix.md), [state](docs/architecture/memory-design.md), [permissions](docs/architecture/permission-model.md), [runtime policies](docs/architecture/runtime-policy-catalog.md), [candidate evaluation](docs/architecture/evaluation-table.md), then [structural constraints](docs/code-governance/structural-constraints.md), [tool rules](docs/code-governance/mcp-tool-manifest.md) and [covenant](.agent/rules.md).
8: 
9: After reading this entry point, follow [Prompt.md](Prompt.md) as the shared launch prompt. Plan first: name requirements and invariants, list exact files and contracts, specify independent normal/negative tests and rollback. Stop for recorded human approval of plan and tests before generating any implementation. Use the approved path list on each tool request. Configured writable paths are an outer limit; task approval may narrow them further. Governance, baseline history, existing tests and external data are frozen to the agent.
10: 
11: Verify imports and module boundaries, baseline regressions, each fit criterion and safety counterexamples. Offline runs use fixed fixtures and fake transport; live checks are separate and human-run. Record commands/results and actual interventions; mark unrun checks honestly. Submit a proposed change for human review; never merge, publish or widen permissions yourself.
12: 
13: Coordination: one owner per requirement and an explicitly agreed integrator for shared files. Follow the course OpenCode implementation workflow. Keep preparation/review distinct from implementation evidence and record the actual tools, scopes and sessions in the AI-use log. No auxiliary workflow may bypass course-role restrictions.

1: # D9 — OpenCode launch prompt
2: 
3: Read `AGENTS.md` first, then this prompt and the referenced D1–D4 documents in the order prescribed by `AGENTS.md`. Use the course permission configuration and the current approved requirement and architecture revisions. This is the common launch prompt for all five requirements. The human specifies the requirement IDs, working revision and task scope in the session. If any are missing or the documents conflict, ask for clarification and stop. A request to implement a feature is not approval to begin coding.
4: 
5: ## Gate 1 — Plan and stop (`course-plan`)
6: 
7: Work read-only. Produce an execution plan covering:
8: 
9: 1. **Traceability:** map every selected D1 acceptance criterion and applicable invariant to its D2 component and planned test. Identify any affected shared boundary.
10: 2. **Interface contracts:** specify inputs, outputs, error states and ownership of each decision. Explain how the design preserves deterministic publication and dispatch rules where applicable.
11: 3. **Scope:** list the exact files to read and change, which baseline code must remain intact, and any explicit exclusions. Identify dependencies on other requirements. Never request broader permissions as a shortcut.
12: 4. **Verification:** specify fixed inputs, expected outcomes and commands for normal cases, negative cases and regressions. Include at least one test that would fail if each affected invariant were bypassed. Say which tests require live services; keep them separate from offline acceptance.
13: 5. **Steps and rollback:** give the order for tests, implementation, integration and self-checks, plus a safe rollback approach.
14: 
15: End with **WAITING FOR PLAN AND TEST APPROVAL**. Do not generate or edit implementation or test code at this gate. The human reviewer records the approved plan, test criteria, exact paths, approver and time. A revision to scope, contracts, invariants or acceptance criteria requires a new plan and approval.
16: 
17: ## Gate 2 — Build only the approved change (`course-build`)
18: 
19: When the human switches to Build, require the approved plan and test reference; do not infer approval from a role switch. Have the human approve allowed edits against the exact reviewed paths. Write only the approved tests first. Ask the human to run them against the pre-change behavior and confirm that the key missing-behavior case fails for the expected reason. Stop for human confirmation of that result before editing production code.
20: 
21: Implement the smallest change that satisfies the approved plan. Respect module boundaries, keep the upstream baseline and existing tests intact, and leave governance, CI and permissions to the human. Do not weaken a test to pass or circumvent a rejected edit. If a new dependency, broader path, changed contract or test change is needed, explain it and stop for review.
22: 
23: Summarize the changes, unresolved risks and D4 checks the human should run. End with **WAITING FOR VERIFICATION EVIDENCE**. Do not use shell or external tools.
24: 
25: ## Gate 3 — Self-check and review (`course-verify`)
26: 
27: Work read-only. Inspect the diff or changed files supplied by the human and map each actual result to its planned check. Request human-run structural checks, earlier regression suites and the affected behavioral and invariant checks. Require normal positive controls and adverse cases; keep unavailable, skipped or unrun checks distinct from passes. For application prompt/model changes, request the agreed fixed semantic evaluation evidence before recommending approval.
28: 
29: Return a proposed review summary: requirement IDs, reviewed revision, tests and results, unmet criteria, risks and recommended verdict. Stop for human review. If evidence shows a defect, propose a repair and repeat the appropriate approval and verification gates. Only the human makes the final verdict and controls Git, publishing and merge.
30: 
31: Keep the actual session and mark human interruptions, redirects, approvals and rejections with their rationale. Give the human a summary for the review memo and AI-use log. Never invent evidence, and keep credentials, student identifiers and raw sessions out of the public repository.
32: 
33: ## Task header and handoff required before Gate 1
34: 
35: The human supplies: selected requirement/invariant IDs; common starting SHA and current feature HEAD; contract revision C0–C5; developer and human reviewer; exact read/edit paths; planned case IDs and fixture revision; Python/dependency and OpenCode versions; offline/live scope; and the place to retain private raw sessions. Missing information is an open item, never filled with a fictional approval.
36: 
37: Read the documentation index, open review items in `docs/review-memo.md`, and `docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md`. If required material is denied by the current allowlist, report the exact missing paths and stop for human maintenance. The registry status `proposed` is not Build approval. Freeze shared fields/signatures with affected owners first. Use mocks to develop independently, then require integrated evidence with the real components.
38: 
39: Before production edits, the human approves the exact test-design revision; implementation approval and final PR approval are distinct. An ImportError, dependency failure, absent module or no collected tests is not the required failing-before behavior evidence. Record such setup gaps separately and obtain an approved approach to test the baseline behavior. After any approved fixture/expectation change, record why and renew review rather than silently moving the target.
40: 
41: Only actual actions belong in the session record. Keep planning and document review distinct from OpenCode implementation sessions, and record the actual tool, scope and session reference in the AI-use log. Follow the course OpenCode implementation workflow. This launch prompt does not authorize another tool to bypass denied actions or turn advisory output into human approval.
42: 
43: 
44: ## Applying interface v1.0
45: 
46: Use the named shared records and callable boundaries in C0–C5; do not reopen or invent different field meanings per feature. A task plan lists exact integration adapters and tests the specified compatibility views. Internal class choices may vary without changing shared records. Apply task-specific entry criteria from the review memo; independent offline work may use approved fixtures. A team's confirmation of this document is not automatic approval of every feature plan/test.
47: 
48: Use the approved product run-profile limit and verify outbound attempts at the transport boundary. Distinguish charged safety slots, known sends and unknown delivery in receipts. Diagnostic limits are separate from product acceptance; charged attempts do not establish billed model usage.

1: # Architecture blueprint
2: 
3: Status: Proposed. Interface version: 1.0. Scope and fit criteria: [D1 registry](docs/req/requirements.yaml). Extend TradingAgents at `upstream-baseline` (`9fa1196fffbcfd9de5146d2dd2869df84ab99838`); retain the single-stock graph, providers, CLI and Python entry points. No brokerage execution, arbitrary prose arithmetic, or new external provider is in scope.
4: 
5: | Requirement | Planned owner module | Contract and authority |
6: | --- | --- | --- |
7: | FR-01 / INV-01 | `tradingagents/graph/publication_gate.py` | Build run-local evidence index, validate candidate rating and argument references, and return an approved decision or blocked status/reason. Model text is advisory. Apply the same outcome before CLI/API/report/memory publication. No free-text fallback around the gate. |
8: | FR-02 | `tradingagents/agents/verified_metrics.py` | Validate provenance, comparable periods, units and operands; produce immutable verified records keyed by metric ID. Resolve controlled fields by ID, not model-supplied values. |
9: | FR-03 | `tradingagents/agents/sentiment_coverage.py` | Normalize three tool results to coverage, source reasons and nullable score. Report and downstream consume the same state. |
10: | NFR-01 / INV-02 | `tradingagents/llm_clients/request_budget.py` | Atomically reserve one slot for each in-scope actual send; scope counters per run, including both model tiers. Disable implicit retry for supported course runs. |
11: | NFR-02 | `tradingagents/llm_clients/context_limit.py` | Prepare final messages for analyst closure and the neutral risk debater; preserve mandatory blocks and reject requests that cannot fit. |
12: 
13: Integrate at existing graph and client seams. At dispatch: prepare final messages → apply context limit where scoped → reserve budget → send. Load existing market and sentiment inputs; attach verified metrics and coverage; run debate and candidate generation; gate candidate before official sinks. Treat any display of intermediate model text as unverified and keep candidate text out of official output on refusal. Historical settlement is outside the metered analysis scope.
14: 
15: Use fixed fixtures and fake transports for deterministic tests, then separately smoke-test configured live integration. Emit run ID, publication status/reason, verified metric counts, sentiment coverage, request count and message byte size without credentials or raw prompts. See [trace matrix](docs/architecture/trace-matrix.md) and [runtime policies](docs/architecture/runtime-policy-catalog.md).
16: 
17: Plan is read-only. A human approves scope, interface and tests before Build starts. A separate reviewer runs verification and records a verdict. Amend D1/D2, tests and governance together when a contract changes; changes to safety enforcement require an ADR and explicit human approval.
18: 
19: ## Integration and change control
20: 
21: [C0–C5](docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md) defines shared records, function boundaries, state keys and failure precedence. Each component owns its authoritative records; legacy report strings remain compatible views. Shared-file changes are integrated by the designated coordinator.
22: 
23: The application retains the upstream package layout. Verify the final submission mapping to the required `src/` and `test/` layout before packaging. Approval and outstanding verification items are recorded in [review records](docs/review-memo.md).

1: # Shared interface contracts
2: 
3: Version: 1.0. Status: Proposed. Shared boundaries use JSON-compatible records. Internal dataclasses, TypedDict or Pydantic models may use adapters that preserve these fields and semantics. ADR-001 records the design decision.
4: 
5: ## Ownership and integration
6: 
7: | Contract | Authority | Producers and consumers |
8: | --- | --- | --- |
9: | C0 run identity and outcome | Run coordinator | All five owner modules, CLI, Python, report and memory |
10: | C1 evidence and publication | FR-01 publication gate | Analyst evidence, accepted arguments, candidate, all official sinks |
11: | C2 verified metrics | FR-02 metric registry | Fundamentals inputs, controlled downstream fields and metric table |
12: | C3 sentiment coverage | FR-03 coverage component | Existing source adapters, analyst, state, report and downstream agents |
13: | C4 dispatch budget | NFR-01 request-budget component | Both model tiers and every in-scope transport send |
14: | C5 prepared context | NFR-02 context component | Analyst closure and neutral risk debater, then C4 |
15: 
16: Shared-file integration owner: EverForests. Feature owners submit narrow patches for state, schema, graph/client and reporting adapters. Task plans identify exact paths. The integrator preserves approved contracts across patches; shared files must not be independently replaced by feature branches.
17: 
18: ## C0 — identity, state and errors
19: 
20: Every authoritative record carries `run_id`, normalized `ticker` and `as_of_date`. Evidence and metric IDs are only resolvable inside that run. Never retrieve a matching-looking ID from a previous run. A restarted run gets a new ID. A metered checkpoint resume is disabled until the counter/state restoration contract is implemented and approved.
21: 
22: Keep three concepts separate:
23: 
24: - Execution: RUNNING, COMPLETED, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE or FAILED. COMPLETED describes the workflow, not approval of a recommendation.
25: - Publication: PENDING, APPROVED or BLOCKED, with reason codes. An official rating is present only on APPROVED.
26: - Data coverage: NO_DATA, PARTIAL_DATA or AVAILABLE for optional sentiment. NO_DATA alone is not a failed run or a publication rejection.
27: 
28: A terminal budget/context failure suppresses the official rating. Valid market/financial evidence can still support publication when sentiment is unavailable, provided C1 passes. Diagnostics are explicitly nonofficial; rejected candidate prose must not leak into an official rating field, final-decision section or decision memory. Fixing a contract requires a versioned D1/D2/test update before dependent work continues.
29: 
30: ## C1 — evidence, accepted arguments and publication
31: 
32: An EvidenceRecord contains `run_id`, `evidence_id`, source kind/vendor, request ticker/window, source locator (URL, document/field or fixture reference), observed period and source content/reference. Assigning an ID does not make empty, failed or unrelated content valid. Missing-source diagnostics can explain absence but are not substantive market evidence.
33: 
34: An AcceptedArgument contains `run_id`, `argument_id`, the claim and a nonempty list of evidence IDs that resolve in the current run. This version verifies reference integrity, not whether a source semantically proves an investment conclusion. A candidate contains an explicit rating and accepted argument IDs. Use the existing five-tier vocabulary: Buy, Overweight, Hold, Underweight, Sell. REVIEW and arbitrary free text are not publishable ratings.
35: 
36: The deterministic gate returns one authoritative PublicationResult: identity, publication status, reasons, approved rating or null, and validated argument/evidence references. Invalid rating uses INVALID_RATING; missing, unknown, cross-run or unaccepted required references use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Diagnostics may retain rejected values privately, but official consumers receive no rejected rating. All four sinks (CLI, Python result, saved official report, decision memory) consume this same result. Structured output, free-text fallback and streaming/final display paths cannot bypass it.
37: 
38: FR-02 adds verified numerical records; FR-01 must not label arbitrary model prose as verified arithmetic. FR-03 missingness does not automatically invalidate other evidence. The v1 result fields below are common to all sinks; name exact sink adapter edits in the relevant feature plan and test each one.
39: 
40: ## C2 — verified metrics
41: 
42: Input: metric kind (YoY, ratio or signed difference), raw operands, source locators/fields, periods, units/currencies and run identity. Use source precision, preferably Decimal-compatible strings. Output: VERIFIED with immutable `metric_id`, normalized operands, formula, result/unit/period and provenance, or UNVERIFIABLE with a reason and no verified value.
43: 
44: - YoY = 100 * (current / prior - 1); compare the same quarter in adjacent years or comparable full years.
45: - Ratio = 100 * numerator / denominator; record dimensional/unit compatibility and period alignment.
46: - Signed difference = current - reference; preserve sign and price unit.
47: - YoY/ratio denominators must be positive in this release. Reject nonfinite values, absent provenance, incompatible units or incomparable periods.
48: - Percentage tolerance is 0.1 **percentage points**, not relative percent. Price-difference tolerance is 0.01 price units. Preserve calculation precision separately from displayed rounding.
49: 
50: Only the owner registry creates authoritative verified records. Consumers resolve IDs against it; a model-supplied value, changed value, unknown ID or new arbitrary ID must not create verification authority. Retain original records for the run and reject conflicting writes.
51: 
52: Real-company acceptance requires archived source operands and independent recomputation. The AAPL YoY field is `Cost of Revenue`. For its signed price-gap example, `current` is the Bollinger upper band and `reference` is the closing price; reversing these roles negates the result. The formula remains `current - reference`, with no absolute-value conversion. Exact operands and evidence status are in the [D4 AAPL examples](../code-governance/verification-constraints.md#fr-02-aapl-acceptance-examples). Synthetic fixtures verify formulas separately. Basis-point calculations and arbitrary narrative-math parsing are outside scope.
53: 
54: ## C3 — sentiment source coverage and nullable score
55: 
56: Three logical sources are `news`, `stocktwits` and `reddit`; Reddit's three subreddits collectively count as one source. Record the actual news vendor; a configured fallback must not be mislabeled Yahoo. Do not add another data provider. For like-for-like baseline checks, record the chosen vendor route.
57: 
58: Each SourceOutcome contains identity, source ID, requested window, availability, valid-record count, reason codes and shareable evidence locators. A source counts once when it returns at least one substantive item attributable to the requested ticker and valid window. Ticker association may come from explicit item metadata or an approved, request-bound adapter; arbitrary substring matches and model assertions are insufficient. Agree and test the supported adapter metadata/placeholder patterns before implementation. An opaque nonempty string is not automatically valid data.
59: 
60: Use the baseline's seven-day-back start and end date: [start 00:00 UTC, end + 1 day 00:00 UTC). AAPL as-of 2026-11-10 therefore covers 2026-11-03 through 2026-11-10. Freeze the clock for date-dependent fixtures. Historical undated content cannot prove window validity. Do not silently tighten or change the baseline date semantics; document any justified change and test boundaries.
61: 
62: Reasons distinguish at least EMPTY, FETCH_ERROR, WINDOW_UNSUPPORTED, OUT_OF_WINDOW, TICKER_MISMATCH and UNVERIFIABLE_METADATA. Keep actual vendor failure distinct from a successful fetch with no matching items. Never claim these statuses prove that no real-world messages/news exist.
63: 
64: | Valid logical sources | coverage_status | Sentiment output |
65: | --- | --- | --- |
66: | 0/3 | NO_DATA | overall_band UNKNOWN; overall_score null |
67: | 1/3 or 2/3 | PARTIAL_DATA | Coverage remains explicit; any measured score uses valid evidence only |
68: | 3/3 | AVAILABLE | Coverage available; score still requires a valid assessment |
69: 
70: Coverage is authoritative data state; the model cannot increase it. With nonzero coverage, permit a finite 0–10 score and an existing band only when an assessment was produced. If assessment fails or its score is absent/invalid, use UNKNOWN/null while retaining the nonzero coverage and an assessment-failure reason; do not mislabel this NO_DATA. A genuine measured Neutral/5.0 remains legal.
71: 
72: Missing scores never become 0 or 5 and never enter a numerical mean. Structured state, analyst message, downstream prompt and persisted/rendered report must agree. Handle nullable scores without numeric-format errors. Apply the contract to structured **and** free-text fallback; model narrative cannot override authoritative coverage. Keep the existing sentiment_report text as a compatibility view; the new sentiment_assessment record below is authoritative. Both must agree. Internal schema adaptation may change, but the v1 shared record does not drift silently.
73: 
74: The original baseline stores `sentiment_report` as text and requires a nonnull numeric SentimentReport score. Updating only the prompt cannot establish this contract. No raw social bodies or credentials belong in public evidence. Missing optional sentiment does not stop otherwise valid market/fundamental analysis; C1 still decides publication.
75: 
76: ## C4 — atomic per-run model dispatch
77: 
78: Supported scope: one single-stock main analysis, both model tiers, structured/fallback requests and application retries. Count actual outgoing model attempts, not nodes, tool invocations, callbacks or tokens. Historical settlement is excluded. Disable SDK/transport implicit retries in supported course runs; unsupported hidden-retry modes are outside the verified configuration, not silently compliant.
79: 
80: Budget state: positive integer `limit`, charged sends, active reservations and exhaustion. Atomically reserve capacity before a send so charged sends plus active reservations cannot exceed limit. A reservation transitions once to a charged attempt at the outbound boundary. A provider error after an attempted send consumes the slot; do not refund an ambiguous send. A cancellation proven to precede transport may release an unused reservation. Validate C5 first so context rejection obtains no reservation.
81: 
82: No slot => BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, no request, no official recommendation. Limit 3 allows exactly 3 attempts; the fourth is refused. Concurrent runs do not share counters. Include application fallback/retry attempts separately. C4 does not promise a monetary or token cap. Transport probes must count actual fake sends and check reservation cleanup rather than trusting the reported counter alone.
83: 
84: ## C5 — deterministic prepared context
85: 
86: Initial integration sites: analyst closure and `risk_mgmt/neutral_debator.py` only. Other analyst turns and risk roles are not implicitly covered. Before reserving C4, fully expand/convert the scoped final message sequence into one agreed provider-facing representation.
87: 
88: Canonical v1 measurement: the final provider-facing message array encoded as JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon) without optional whitespace, allow_nan=False, then UTF-8. Use the ChatMessage representation below and freeze byte fixtures before implementation. Do not measure before template expansion or change representation after measuring. Tool schemas and other separately bound fields are excluded from this message metric and must be recorded/bounded separately; this is not a cap on the whole HTTP body.
89: 
90: Required blocks: role/task identity; standing safety/publication rules; ticker/date/run identity; current required evidence/verified metrics/source coverage; and the active tool-call/result exchange. Optional blocks: explicitly marked older discussion/history. A tool-call/result pair is indivisible; if a member is required, preserve the whole pair. Text-wrapped tools retain name, arguments and corresponding result. Removing context cannot delete authoritative evidence/state from storage.
91: 
92: At the configured 65536-byte acceptance cap: short input passes unchanged. If oversized, remove optional groups oldest first (stable original index for ties), reassemble, reinject critical constraints and remeasure. Do not summarize required evidence with another unmetered model call. If required blocks cannot fit or pairing cannot be preserved, return CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE; zero send, reservation and debit. Same normalized input/config produces identical prepared output. Run final retention/pairing checks before C4.
93: 
94: This byte cap does not implement the separate D2 token-budget requirement. ADR-001 records that architecture design and the remaining tokenizer/model-capacity validation. Do not infer token counts from bytes/4 or claim provider safety from 64 KiB alone.
95:

97: 
98: Before implementation, record requirement IDs, contract revision, baseline SHA, exact read/edit paths, fixture/case revision, reviewer and approval time. The human approval record identifies the reviewed revision and scope. Reapprove changes to shared fields, thresholds, test expectations, safety paths or dependencies. Feature PRs link the approved plan and actual evidence; the coordinator runs integrated regressions before release.

101: ## V1 shared record layout
102: 
103: Version field: `contract_version = "1.0"`. Shared artifacts carry `run_id`, normalized `ticker` and ISO `as_of_date` copied from RunContext. Nonsecret IDs are opaque strings; consumers must not infer meaning from their spelling. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. A missing optional value is explicit null; a missing required field is an invalid record. Lists have deterministic order; ID-indexed registries are mappings, not unordered output prose.
104: 
105: | Record | Required shared fields beyond identity | Owner |
106: | --- | --- | --- |
107: | RunContext | contract_version, execution_status, request_limit (positive integer) | Existing graph/run entry; integration by coordinator |
108: | EvidenceRecord | evidence_id, source_kind, vendor, source_ref, content_ref, window_start, window_end | FR-01 collection/index adapter |
109: | AcceptedArgument | argument_id, claim (nonempty text), evidence_ids (nonempty list) | FR-01 validates against run-local evidence; a model flag is not acceptance |
110: | CandidateDecision | rating (untrusted string or null), argument_ids | Model/adapters produce; C1 decides |
111: | PublicationResult | publication_status, reason_codes, rating (allowed string or null), argument_ids, evidence_ids | FR-01 |
112: | Operand | role, value (finite decimal string), unit, period, source_ref, field_ref | FR-02 input adapter; roles current/prior/numerator/denominator/reference |
113: | MetricRequest | kind (yoy/ratio/price_delta), operands | FR-02 input |
114: | VerifiedMetric | metric_id, kind, operands, result_value (decimal string), result_unit, formula, source_refs | FR-02 immutable run-local registry |
115: | MetricResult | status (VERIFIED/UNVERIFIABLE), metric (VerifiedMetric or null), reason_codes | FR-02 |
116: | SourceOutcome | source_id, window_start, window_end, available (bool), valid_record_count, reason_codes, evidence_refs | FR-03 normalization adapter |
117: | SentimentCoverage | coverage_status, valid_sources, total_sources (=3), sources (mapping keyed news/stocktwits/reddit) | FR-03 deterministic coverage |
118: | SentimentAssessment | all SentimentCoverage fields, assessment_status (MEASURED/UNKNOWN), overall_band, overall_score, confidence, assessment_reason_codes, narrative | FR-03 deterministic finalization |
119: | ContextBlock | group_id, required (bool), messages (list of ChatMessage); grouping metadata is never sent to the model | NFR-02 scoped adapter |
120: | PreparedRequest | status (READY/CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE), messages (list or null), message_bytes, original_message_bytes, dropped_group_ids, required_groups_ok | NFR-02 or nonreducing adapter |
121: | Reservation | reservation_id, run_id, state (reserved/charged/cancelled); opaque to other features | NFR-01 |
122: 
123: `Operand.period` is `{kind, start, end, label}`: kind is quarter/year/instant, start/end are ISO dates, and label records the source's fiscal period or quote timestamp. Currency and scale are part of unit (for example USD vs USD_millions); conversion must be explicit and preserve original operands. Do not silently take abs(capex), invent comparable periods or round source values to make a fixture match. An EvidenceRecord source_ref identifies the source, while content_ref locates the retained shareable material/fixture; an ID with no resolvable retained material is insufficient.
124: 
125: For SentimentAssessment, overall_band is one existing measured band or UNKNOWN. overall_score is a finite float in [0,10] for MEASURED, otherwise null. confidence keeps the existing low/medium/high vocabulary; UNKNOWN uses low and is not a measured weak-neutral signal. Missing sources are unavailable with reasons; valid sources have valid_record_count >=1. Missing uncollected source entries are normalized as unavailable with NOT_COLLECTED rather than increasing the denominator or silently disappearing. Extra providers do not count as fourth sources. Source order is news, stocktwits, reddit.
126: 
127: `ChatMessage` contains provider-facing role, content and, when present, name/tool_call_id/tool_calls/reasoning_content. Preserve content strings or JSON-compatible content blocks without paraphrasing. Preserve each tool call's id, type, function name and arguments plus the paired tool result. Reasoning fields required by the selected provider's tool round-trip are mandatory if present. Do not add ContextBlock metadata to ChatMessage. The cap measures the agreed canonical message representation, not HTTP whitespace, the whole body, output tokens or hidden provider overhead.

129: ## V1 callable boundaries (specification signatures, no implementation)
130: 
131: Inputs are read-only to consumers. Return the declared records; do not attach extra authoritative fields through prose. Signatures below describe Python-callable boundaries; they do not create five network services.
132: 
133: | Planned owner | Public v1 call | Behavior |
134: | --- | --- | --- |
135: | publication_gate.py | validate_argument(argument, evidence_index, run) -> AcceptedArgument or validation failure | Check current-run references before acceptance |
136: | publication_gate.py | evaluate_publication(candidate, argument_index, evidence_index, run) -> PublicationResult | Recheck accepted references and rating; one result for all official sinks |
137: | verified_metrics.py | verify_metric(request, run) -> MetricResult | Compute from validated operands, register only verified records |
138: | verified_metrics.py | resolve_metric(metric_id, registry, run) -> VerifiedMetric or null | Resolve trusted ID; never accept a caller-supplied replacement value |
139: | sentiment_coverage.py | normalize_source(raw_result, source_id, run, window_start, window_end) -> SourceOutcome | Derive availability from collection receipts and approved metadata rules |
140: | sentiment_coverage.py | build_sentiment_coverage(sources, run) -> SentimentCoverage | Count three logical sources once each |
141: | sentiment_coverage.py | finalize_sentiment(coverage, model_assessment_or_null, run) -> SentimentAssessment | Coverage is authoritative; validate score/band; no imputation |
142: | context_limit.py | prepare_context(blocks, max_message_bytes=65536) -> PreparedRequest | Only the two scoped sites reduce; reject irreducible context |
143: | request_budget.py | RequestBudget(run_id, limit); try_reserve() -> Reservation or null; charge_attempt(ticket); cancel_before_send(ticket); snapshot() | Atomic lifecycle; cancellation only when transport is known not to have started |
144: | request_budget.py | dispatch(prepared, budget, send) -> sender's normal response type | Require READY, reserve, charge at attempt boundary, invoke send exactly once; refusal is a typed failure, never a Hold/default rating |
145: 
146: The sender callable accepts the prepared messages and performs exactly one underlying request with SDK retries disabled. Application fallback/retries call dispatch again. Dispatch failure types are BudgetExhausted, ContextTooLarge and ProviderFailure (defined in the responsible owner module); the graph entry maps them to C0 terminal state. Provider failures after an ambiguous attempt remain charged. Snapshot separates charged attempts, known actual sends and unknown-delivery attempts; a connection attempt is not claimed to be a billed model response.
147: 
148: Publication evaluation first respects C0 terminal failure/incomplete execution (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE or RUN_NOT_COMPLETE); then rejects an invalid rating; then rejects insufficient references. APPROVED has an allowed rating, nonempty accepted argument/evidence references and no rejection reasons. BLOCKED always has rating=null. An incomplete workflow cannot publish an earlier candidate.

150: ## V1 graph handoff and compatibility
151: 
152: Add the following keys to the existing AgentState through narrow integration edits: course_run (RunContext), evidence_index, argument_index, verified_metrics, sentiment_assessment and publication_result. These are separate state keys; do not have parallel nodes overwrite an entire common nested dictionary. Existing nodes own their existing report strings. New owner records are not reconstructed from those strings. Avoid new dependencies or replacement of the orchestrator.
153: 
154: For sentiment, the analyst emits sentiment_assessment and renders its legacy sentiment_report from that same record, including the model-message/report views. At 0/3, the selected v1 path skips the sentiment model call and creates a deterministic missing-data narrative with UNKNOWN/null. With data, finalize the model assessment while preserving coverage; provider/free-text fallback cannot restore a made-up default score. The FR-03 task plan tests schema/renderer compatibility before selecting the internal Pydantic adaptation. FR-01 can publish from valid non-sentiment evidence when its own gate passes.
155: 
156: The shared model client receives PreparedRequest. At the two NFR-02 sites use prepare_context; elsewhere use a nonreducing READY adapter so NFR-01 covers all sends without accidentally applying a 64 KiB cap to every call. All branches then use the same C4 dispatch boundary. Tests can use fixed fake producers/consumers until integration, but combined graph acceptance needs the real connected owner modules.

2: 
3: The [D1 registry](../req/requirements.yaml) defines the acceptance criteria. The [trace matrix](../architecture/trace-matrix.md) maps them to components and monitors. The cases below are planned, not test results.
4: 
5: Before implementation, a human reviewer approves the plan and independently specified tests. Record the approver, time and link to the reviewed revision. Each test must name the FR, NFR or INV it verifies in its name, docstring or documented case mapping. Every fit criterion must have at least one test and every invariant at least one negative test that fails if the enforcement is bypassed. Confirm that positive controls pass; a system that rejects everything does not satisfy acceptance.
6: 
7: | ID | Minimum offline checks | Evidence to retain |
8: | --- | --- | --- |
9: | FR-01 | Exercise valid rating plus resolvable evidence, illegal rating, missing reference, unknown ID and cross-run ID at both entry points. Check approved trace from recommendation to source, and verify refusal status and reason. | Case IDs, CLI/API outcomes and trace example |
10: | INV-01 | Inject a rejected Buy; assert no official rating in CLI, API, report or decision memory. Demonstrate that bypassing the gate or leaking to any sink fails a test. | Negative assertions for all four sinks |
11: | FR-02 | Freeze source operands and recompute all four D1 examples with the stated tolerances and formulas. Test signed subtraction, equivalent reporting periods, mismatched periods/units, missing provenance, nonfinite operands, nonpositive denominators, altered values, unknown IDs and newly constructed invalid records. Assert downstream fields and report use the same verified ID; invalid operands return UNVERIFIABLE. | Operand provenance, expected result and tolerance per fixture; verified-record and report assertions |
12: | FR-03 | Test 0/3, 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 sources, genuine neutral, empty/error responses and wrong symbol/window. Check source reasons and consistency across state, report and downstream input. Assert null is not imputed or averaged and valid market/financial analysis continues. | Input fixtures, coverage and score assertions, continuation evidence |
13: | NFR-01 | With limit 3, verify exactly three requests can complete; a fourth is not sent, yields BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, and no official rating appears. Check independent concurrent runs, supported retry configuration and settlement exclusion. Count at fake transport, not at the UI. | Dispatch trace with scoped request counts and outcomes |
14: | INV-02 | Race two calls for the final slot; assert at most one outbound request. Include a deterministic synchronization point so a reservation bypass cannot pass by scheduling luck. | Concurrent send assertions and isolation evidence |
15: | NFR-02 | Cover both designated call sites with short, reducible, irreducible and multibyte examples. Measure final UTF-8 messages against 65536 bytes under the proposed config, excluding bound schemas. Assert identical reduction for identical input, full required-block retention, intact tool pairing and zero sends/debits for CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE. | Before/after byte counts and mandatory-block assertions |

17: Verification has three tiers:
18: 
19: 1. **Structural:** validate the D1 registry against its schema and check unique IDs; check lint, typing and dependencies. Inspect import boundaries, one owner per responsibility, the shared publication/dispatch routes and OpenCode's effective role/path permissions. For safety-path changes verify contracts, API surface, permission least privilege and security checks. An approval request must not grant authority to frozen files.
20: 2. **Regression:** for every implementation round run all suites from earlier rounds, including upstream `tests/` and accumulated `test/offline/`, with zero regressions. Record exact commands, revision, environment, skipped tests and results. Air-gapped tests use fixed inputs, fake transports and isolated state; a live smoke run is separate and cannot replace offline coverage. An unavailable check is not a pass.
21: 3. **Behavioral:** apply the table to each affected feature and together at the two shared boundaries. A context rejection must not spend a request slot. A budget stop or release rejection must not publish a recommendation. Compare performance only with equivalent inputs, config, and completion; report early exits separately. Prompt/model changes require a fixed semantic evaluation set and agreed thresholds before merge; check source support separately from existence of an ID, and require zero safety escapes. Agree and record any quality threshold not already in D1 before running the evaluation.

29: | Case IDs | Fixed design / expected result |
30: | --- | --- |
31: | T-FR01-VALID, T-FR01-RATING, T-FR01-MISSING, T-FR01-REFERENCE, T-FR01-SINKS | One current-run evidence E1 and accepted argument A1 -> legal rating publishes; illegal rating, absent argument, unknown/cross-run E1 -> refusal. Inspect CLI/API/report/memory, not just the gate return. |

33: | T-FR02-INVALID, T-FR02-IDENTITY | Zero/negative denominator, NaN/Inf, missing provenance, period/unit mismatch -> UNVERIFIABLE; changed value, unknown ID and newly forged record cannot enter verified fields. Real-company examples require the primary-source provenance specified below. |
34: | T-FR03-COVERAGE | All source-validity combinations (8 combinations for 3 sources): 0 -> NO_DATA/UNKNOWN/null; 1 or 2 -> PARTIAL_DATA with exact count; 3 -> AVAILABLE. Reddit subreddits never increase denominator above 3. |

43: | T-INV01-BYPASS | Deliberately bypass one official sink's gate in a controlled test: the negative assertion must fail. Restore code; never merge the deliberate violation. |

Assert both subtraction directions so an absolute-value implementation fails the negative-direction case. The same metric ID/value must reach controlled downstream fields and the final metrics table.

These arithmetic checks do not establish implementation acceptance or the correctness of model-generated narrative. NVDA/MSFT source fixtures remain required.

59: ## Execution, collection and semantic changes
60: 
61: Record Python/dependency versions, source SHA, test/fixture revision, clock, configuration and completion status. Commands below apply **after** executable course tests have been added; an empty directory, exit code 5 or skipped scaffold is not a pass:
62: 
63: - Collection: `python -m pytest --collect-only -q test/offline`.
64: - Offline regression: `python -m pytest -q tests test/offline -m "not integration"`.
65: - Live checks, explicitly authorized with private credentials: `python -m pytest -q test/live -m integration`.
66: - Patch hygiene: `git diff --check`; include untracked files in review separately.
67: 
68: The current default `testpaths = ["tests"]` does not collect `test/offline`. D7 must explicitly collect accumulated course tests and fail when required cases are absent/skipped. Do not install dependencies or make external requests during deterministic offline checks. Use isolated caches/memory and fake transports; actual fake-send counts are independent evidence.
69: 
70: Before any application prompt/model change merges, freeze an evaluation revision in Git with exact inputs and expected facts, plus the model/config/prompt revisions. Proposed initial semantic set: valid citation, unknown citation, zero sentiment sources, genuine neutral, partial coverage, synthetic YoY and invalid metric provenance. Supply complete synthetic content and expected fact/rubric annotations, not only scenario names; these executable/evaluation fixtures are still to be prepared and approved. Proposed thresholds: 100% required-field/coverage agreement, 100% citation resolvability where publication is allowed, zero safety escapes and zero contradiction of declared missing-data facts; human source-support review uses a predeclared rubric and threshold before the first evaluation. Reference existence alone is not semantic faithfulness. Do not tune thresholds after seeing a result or count early refusal as a quality/performance gain.

80: | Regression | Upstream and all previous course offline suites collected, no unexplained missing/skipped acceptance cases |
81: | AI-use log | Code/application-prompt PR updates the log with real tool/session and scope; missing entry blocks |
82: 
83: Repository administrators configure required checks and safety review/ADR protection, then verify enforcement with a controlled failing PR. Record each gate's implementation and enforcement evidence in the review memo.

86: ## Interface-v1 conformance
87: 
88: Before implementing the selected feature, freeze fixtures for its v1 record fields and call boundaries. Check run/version isolation, required fields, null semantics and compatibility views. C3's 0/3 branch must make zero sentiment-model requests, while allowing other valid analysis to proceed; include this in T-FR03-COVERAGE/PROPAGATION. C1 refuses incomplete/terminal runs without leaking a candidate. C4 dispatch preserves the sender's normal response type on success and exposes typed failure instead of inventing a rating. C5 tests canonical JSON message sizing and never counts grouping metadata or treats an unscoped call as a 64 KiB scoped call.
89: 
90: Use the approved run profile and fixed acceptance fixtures. Product request limits, boundary fixtures and diagnostic limits are distinct configurations. Keep synthetic results, controlled live diagnostics and unchanged-configuration baseline comparisons separately identified. 100:     absent from this run and disabled HTML. Other files and directories are kept.
101:     """

126:     # since callers may keep notes or other artifacts alongside the reports.
127:     current_files = {

129:         for _heading, folder, written in parts
130:         for _agent, filename, _text in written
131:     }

1: # Memory and state design

3: | Requirement | Session state and lifecycle |
4: | --- | --- |
5: | FR-01 | Evidence/argument IDs and candidate status are scoped to one run; only allowed decisions reach existing decision memory. Do not resolve references from a prior run. |
6: | FR-02 | Verified records are immutable within a run; report may retain source references and immutable calculation records. No user-wide metric cache in first release. |
7: | FR-03 | Coverage and reasons are run-local; avoid persisting raw social responses. |
8: | NFR-01 | Counter is run-local; a resumed metered run must not reset spent slots. Disable upstream checkpoint resume for metered course runs until counters can be restored atomically; restart is a distinct run. |
9: | NFR-02 | Reduction is per request; optional context may be dropped from the sent payload only, not silently erased from approved evidence records. |
10: 
11: Reuse the upstream user-owned decision log for approved decisions only and retain its configured rotation/deletion behavior. Keep course fixtures isolated from users' local caches and memory. Reports may contain nonsecret source metadata; users control local retention. No credentials, raw model sessions or student identifiers belong in public logs. Repeatability claims require a new run or an explicitly versioned snapshot, not a retained LLM answer.

14: 
15: Use C0 identity and C1–C3 authoritative records from [interface-contracts.md](interface-contracts.md). Add coverage/assessment state beside existing sentiment text; downstream readers use authoritative fields rather than reparsing a Neutral placeholder. Keep data coverage, assessment failure, execution completion and publication approval separate. New runs never inherit prior scores, references or counters.

Keep original private run receipts separately from shareable, synthetic test fixtures; record only approved references/hashes in public artifacts. 1: # ADR-001 — Deterministic extensions at existing application boundaries
2: 
3: Status: Proposed. Interface version: 1.0.
4: 
5: ## Context and drivers
6: 
7: The extension preserves the existing single-stock graph, model clients, data providers and publication paths. Architectural drivers are verifiable outputs, explicit degraded behavior, bounded dispatch, limited baseline changes and independent offline acceptance tests.
8: 
9: ## Decision process and alternatives
10: 
11: Trace the existing dispatch and publication paths, compare the candidates in the [evaluation table](../evaluation-table.md), define shared contracts and review adverse cases before implementation.
12: 
13: | Option | Assessment |
14: |---|---|
15: | Prompt and configuration changes only | Insufficient enforcement of publication, arithmetic, missing-data state and total request limits |
16: | Deterministic components at existing boundaries | Selected; supports the five acceptance contracts with localized integration |
17: | Replacement orchestration | Deferred; increases migration and regression scope without an identified requirement |
18: 
19: ## Component decisions
20: 
21: | Requirement | Decision |
22: |---|---|
23: | FR-01 | Resolve current-run evidence and apply one publication result at every official sink |
24: | FR-02 | Compute from validated operands; resolve immutable verified records by ID |
25: | FR-03 | Separate source coverage, assessment and execution state; 0/3 yields UNKNOWN/null without a sentiment-model call |
26: | NFR-01 | Atomically reserve capacity at a common outbound boundary |
27: | NFR-02 | Reduce optional history at the two scoped sites; reject irreducible messages before budget reservation |
28: 
29: Use [C0–C5](../interface-contracts.md) JSON-compatible shared records. Internal types may use adapters. Add separate owner keys to AgentState and retain legacy report strings as views of authoritative records.
30: 
31: ## Layered model context
32: 
33: Context layers are role/task identity, standing constraints, typed evidence and run state, active tool exchanges, optional discussion history and the current request. Mark required blocks explicitly.
34: 
35: Assembly order: prioritize and deduplicate optional history; measure the final representation; remove optional groups oldest first; reassemble; re-inject critical constraints; verify required blocks and tool pairs; recount before dispatch. Preserve authoritative stored evidence when reducing a request. Refuse a scoped request when mandatory content cannot fit.
36: 
37: NFR-02 uses a configurable 65536-byte message cap at analyst closure and the neutral risk role. It excludes separately bound tool schemas and is independent of token measurement.
38: 
39: ## Token-budget design
40: 
41: The input-token design uses a proposed cap of 16384 tokens and a compaction trigger above 13107 tokens (floor of 80% of the cap). Configure output allowance and provider-envelope reserve independently. Validate the selected model capacity, counting method, schema overhead and provider conversion before enabling this policy. Until then, token enforcement remains unverified. Byte counts are not a substitute for token counts.
42: 
43: ## Run profile
44: 
45: The initial product profile uses a configurable request limit of 40, both tiers on the school model alias, explicit thinking-disabled requests and an output allowance of 4096 tokens. NFR-01 boundary fixtures use limit 3. Configuration evidence accompanies baseline comparisons; changes to public semantics require a contract revision.
46: 
47: ## Consequences and review triggers
48: 
49: Benefits are localized changes and explicit failure states. Costs are shared dispatch/publication integration and nullable-state compatibility across existing consumers. Review this decision when provider retries become opaque, a sink bypasses publication checks, required context routinely cannot fit, or requirements need different orchestration.
50: 
51: Changes to shared fields, date semantics, thresholds, safety behavior or dependencies require affected-owner review and synchronized requirements, interfaces and tests. Record the human decision and supporting evidence.

It is the source of truth; [permissions.jsonc](../../.opencode/permissions.jsonc) is its identical course-delivery copy, not a second configuration source. Keep them identical (`git diff --no-index .opencode/opencode.jsonc .opencode/permissions.jsonc`). Secrets, project rules, course requirements, existing tests, CI and Git are never agent-editable. Human approves only the exact implementation paths in the plan; do not select an approval that persists beyond the immediate action.

Verify the project config source, both rule files, and the three course roles. V2 does not use the previous `--pure` workflow: inspect configured plugins and MCP tools separately, and use a clean profile if unrelated integrations or overrides remain.

Build must ask before editing a designated module and deny a frozen path such as `AGENTS.md`. Decline the probe edit. Confirm the guard outcomes in the actual tool session; config discovery alone is not enforcement evidence. Do not publish config dumps. These are tool-level controls, not an OS sandbox; any failed guard check blocks agent use.

Before a task depends on one, the human maintainer must review its exact path and update both configuration copies consistently if access is needed. Tool boundaries and evidence responsibilities are defined in the [tool manifest](../code-governance/mcp-tool-manifest.md).

1: # Runtime policy catalog
2: 
3: | Requirement | Trigger | Deterministic action / decision | Evidence to capture | Escalation or continuation |
4: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
5: | FR-01 / INV-01 | Invalid rating or unresolved required evidence | Fail closed; never publish/persist rejected candidate | run ID, BLOCKED, INVALID_RATING/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, rejected-reference IDs without raw content | Stop publication; provide nonofficial diagnostic for human correction/rerun |
6: | FR-02 | Invalid/missing operand, provenance, unit or period | Exclude from verified metrics; UNVERIFIABLE | metric ID/reference, formula and sanitized validation reason | Continue other valid records; owner reviews unsupported source/period |
7: | FR-03 | Missing/invalid optional sentiment source | Preserve coverage/reasons; zero coverage -> UNKNOWN/null | source ID, requested window, valid-source count and missing reasons | Continue usable market/financial analysis; do not imply real-world silence |
8: | NFR-01 / INV-02 | No reservation available | Abort main analysis before send and deny publication | run ID, limit, charged/reserved count, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED | Human may start a new explicitly identified/configured run; never reset same-run counter |
9: | NFR-02 | Context above cap | Reduce optional groups preserving required pairs; irreducible -> CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE before reserve/send | scoped call site, bytes before/after, required retention/pair check, zero-send/debit assertion | Refuse affected run's official outcome; owner reviews required-block scope or cap before rerun |
10: 
11: A provider failure after dispatch consumes the slot; no implicit retries are allowed in supported metered runs. Runtime diagnostic outputs must not masquerade as official recommendations.
12: 
13: ## Combined-path precedence (C0–C5)
14: 
15: 1. Validate/reduce scoped context before reserving a model slot. CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE means no send or budget debit for that rejected request.
16: 2. If context is ready but C4 has no slot, return BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Both terminal paths suppress any earlier candidate as an official final recommendation.
17: 3. Invalid financial records are excluded; optional sentiment failures preserve per-source reasons and UNKNOWN/null where appropriate. Continue usable analysis rather than treating absent sentiment as a neutral signal or unconditional publication failure.
18: 4. On nonzero source coverage but failed assessment, keep PARTIAL_DATA/AVAILABLE and record assessment failure with UNKNOWN/null. Coverage is collection state, not model confidence.
19: 5. Gate any resulting candidate at every official sink. A source placeholder is not substantive evidence. Publication passes only when C1 succeeds, regardless of a model's requested rating.
20: 
21: A user retry after a terminal failure is a new run with a new identity; do not resume the same metered identity with a fresh counter. Invalid configuration or unknown contract version blocks the affected task before live dispatch. Record implementation and case evidence for each failure path.
22: 
23: Each enforcing component emits the specified receipt fields. Verification records identify the producing path, implementation revision and observed result.

## 二、FR-02 范围（我的理解）

- **D1 原文**：从带来源、期间和单位的操作数计算约定指标；受控下游字段与最终指标表必须按 `metric_id` 引用**同一条不可变**已验证记录。
- **契约**：C0（身份/状态/错误）+ C2（验证指标）。
- **负责人**：`tradingagents/agents/verified_metrics.py`（拟新增，owner 模块）。
- **明确排除**：任意散文算术、基点变化、来源数据本身的真实性、绝对数回补、自动取 `abs()`。
- **失败行为**（runtime-policy）：任一操作数、来源、单位或期间无效 → 记为 **UNVERIFIABLE** 并排除在已验证指标之外，但**不影响其他有效记录**继续分析。
- **内存策略**：记录在一个 run 内不可变；首版**没有**跨用户指标缓存；冲突写入要拒绝。

---

## 三、C0 与 C2 要点复述

**C0**：所有权威记录携带 `run_id`、规范化 `ticker`、ISO `as_of_date`；`metric_id` 只在**本次 run 内**可解析，绝不跨 run 复用；重启用新 ID。要区分三种概念：执行状态（RUNNING/COMPLETED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE/FAILED）、发布状态（PENDING/APPROVED/BLOCKED）、数据覆盖（NO_DATA/PARTIAL_DATA/AVAILABLE）。COMPLETED 不等于推荐被批准。

**C2**：
- 输入：指标类型（yoy / ratio / price_delta）、原始操作数、来源定位或字段、期间、单位或币种、run 身份；用源码精度，优先 Decimal 兼容字符串。
- 输出：**VERIFIED**（带不可变 `metric_id`、规范化操作数、公式、结果/单位/期间、来源）或 **UNVERIFIABLE**（原因码，无已验证值）。
- 公式：YoY = `100*(current/prior-1)`，比较相邻年份同一季度或可比完整年度；Ratio = `100*numerator/denominator`，需记录量纲/单位兼容与期间对齐；有符号差 = `current - reference`，保留符号与价格单位。
- 版本约束：YoY/ratio 分母必须为正；拒绝非有限值、缺来源、单位不兼容、期间不可比。
- **只有 registry 能创建**权威记录；消费者按 ID 解析；模型提供值、被改值、未知 ID、新造 ID 都**不能**获得验证权威。
- 从 C2 引用的 **D4 AAPL 示例**就是本次的权威验收表。

---

## 四、五个案例逐项复述

| 案例 | 固定内容 | 期望与容差 |
|---|---|---|
| **T-FR02-YOY** | 合成对照：prior 100 / current 125 → 25%。真实示例：AAPL `Cost of Revenue`，current = 245232（FY2026），prior = 220960（FY2025），可比完整年度，USD_millions | `100*(245232/220960-1) = 10.9847936278…%`，显示 10.98%。百分比误差 ≤ **0.1 个百分点** |
| **T-FR02-RATIO** | 合成对照：同期间 numerator 20 / denominator 80 → 25%。MSFT 示例的输入见你提供的数据（capex 115948 / OCF 182935，FY2026，USD_millions） | 目标 63.38%。百分比误差 ≤ 0.1 个百分点；分母必须 > 0 |
| **T-FR02-DELTA** | 合成对照：同单位 current 10.125 / reference 5.599 → +4.526，反向 → −4.526。真实示例：AAPL 2026-11-10，current = boll_ub = 352.771，reference = Close = 348.245，USD | +4.526 USD；反向 **−4.526 USD**。价格误差 ≤ **0.01 价格单位**；必须同时验证两个符号方向，绝对值的实现会失败 |
| **T-FR02-INVALID** | 零/负分母、NaN/Inf、缺来源、期间不匹配、单位不匹配 | 一律 **UNVERIFIABLE**，并带原因码；已验证字段内**零条无效记录** |
| **T-FR02-IDENTITY** | 改值、未知 ID、新造伪造记录 | 不能进入已验证字段，也不能绕过重算。下游字段和最终表必须通过 **同一个 `metric_id`** 解析出同一个 `VerifiedMetric` |

**下游与最终表如何引用同一条记录**：C2 的输出 `VerifiedMetric` 由 registry 持有；`MetricResult` 携带「状态 + metric 或 null + reason_codes」；受控下游字段和最终指标表只能持 `metric_id`，再通过 `resolve_metric(metric_id, registry, run)` 解析；任何消费者自带替换值的做法都会被拒绝。V1 的记录字段为：`Operand`（role 为 current/prior/numerator/denominator/reference，value 为有限十进制字符串，带 unit、period、source_ref、field_ref）、`MetricRequest`（kind 为 yoy/ratio/price_delta，带 operands）、`VerifiedMetric`、`MetricResult`。操作数精度独立于显示四舍五入；不得为了迁就 fixture 而取绝对值或重新取整。

---

# 第二轮补读：约束、正常接入点与仍缺材料

## 一、本轮实际读取（全部只读，成功）

`structural-constraints.md`、`mcp-tool-manifest.md`、`.agent/rules.md`、`.opencode/rules.md`、`docs/req/product.yaml`、`docs/req/req-schema.json`、`tradingagents/agents/analysts/turn.py`、`tradingagents/graph/propagation.py`、`tradingagents/agents/managers/portfolio_manager.py`。

本轮**没有**重试任何被拒路径，没有列目录、读权限配置、读债务记录、追 vendor 源码，没改文件，没跑命令。

---

## 二、补到的约束（与 FR-02 直接相关）

**结构约束**
- FR-02 的所有权边界明确：**`verified_metrics` 独占“算术 + 引用解析”**，下游只负责“渲染已解析的值”（第 8 行）。因此 fundamentals analyst、reporting、portfolio manager 都**不得**自行做除法、减法或容差判断。
- 每个新增或修改的模块和函数，都要在注释或 docstring 里写明关联的 **requirement、ADR 和 invariant**。
- 集成代码可以编排，但**不能覆盖权威拒绝**（这条与 FR-02 的 UNVERIFIABLE 直接相关）。
- 禁止跨层 import、新增 provider 或依赖；不得复制业务规则到 CLI/API/report。
- 只用 fake producer/consumer 跑通的测试，**不算**集成证据；最终要有真实组件接入的证据。
- 契约所有权必须先冻结：state/schema、reporting、dispatch 属于共享文件，需要点名集成负责人和精确路径（以现在的 `permission-model.md` 为准，共享文件负责人是 EverForests）。

**.agent/rules.md（项目公约）**
- 每个新设计责任一个**小 owner 模块**，只在有重复行为或已批准接口时才加抽象。
- 测试与实现分离；**先批准测试再实现**；每项功能至少一个负例；不可为让坏实现通过而改测试。
- 发布与调度守卫代码视为安全关键；修改需 ADR + 明确人工批准。FR-02 本身不算 publication/dispatch 守卫，但它输出的已验证记录会被 C1 门使用。
- 需求变更时，owner 必须在同一 sprint 内同步架构、策略、测试和追踪；契约过期则暂停任务。

**.opencode/rules.md（人工维护）**
- Plan/Verify 只读；人工未批准 scope/test/contract 前不得 Build 编辑；deny by default，每次编辑按精确路径批准。
- 不可编辑该文件、D1/D2、权限、密钥、CI、基线测试、Git 元数据；无 shell、外部工具、网络、委派。
- 模型输出不可信；被阻塞或不支持的情况必须显式报告（这与 UNVERIFIABLE 的处理方式一致）。
- 只用合成或可共享 fixture；不允许出现凭据、个人数据、原始会话。
- **请人工自己跑测试并提供结果**，不能编造通过结果。

**MCP 工具清单**
- 本任务不需要也不批准 MCP；应用的数据/模型 provider 是运行时依赖，不是授予编码 Agent 的工具。
- Plan 只能读白名单的治理与集成文件，禁止编辑、shell、委派、网络。

**product.yaml**
- FR-02 属于范围内（`scope` 列出 FR-01/02/03、NFR-01/02）；`out_of_scope` 明确 **“对叙述文本中任意算术的验证”**，与 D1 的 FR-02 取舍一致。
- `acceptance.mode`：离线 fixture + fake transport，在线单独进行。
- `ready_to_build: Requires approved contracts, task plan/test revision and effective exact-path permissions` —— 现在三项都还没齐（契约 Proposed、计划/测试未批准、读取权限刚刚只部分放行）。
- 状态：`proposed; review pending`。基线提交 `9fa1196…`。

**req-schema.json**
- 这是 D1 的校验 schema，本身对 FR-02 没有额外业务规则，但有几条硬约束：
  - `contracts` 数组用 `^C[0-5]$` 校验，FR-02 当前是 `["C0","C2"]`，符合。
  - `test_cases` 用 `^T-(FR|NFR|INV)[0-9]{2}-[A-Z0-9]+$` 校验，现有五个 FR-02 用例 ID 都符合。
  - `FR-*` 的 `type` 必须是 `functional`；`fit` 必须有 `metric/threshold/verification` 三项。
  - 唯一性和交叉引用（唯一 ID、测试/契约能否解析）**不靠 schema 保证**，要靠语义校验门（第 35 行注释）。所以你来源表里的新 case ID 或 fixture 版本一旦改名或新增，都要走版本化更新，我不能自行改 D1。

---

## 三、正常接入点（代码事实）

**1. 工具回包与报告：`turn.py`**
- 分析师的工具轮在这里发生：`(prompt | llm.bind_tools(tools)).invoke(messages)`，返回 `(result, report)`；有 `tool_calls` 时 `report` 为 `""`，否则 `report = result.content`。
- 最后一轮（`WRAP_UP`）不绑定工具，历史里的工具调用与结果被 `_as_text` 改写成纯文本：`AIMessage("[Called name(args)]")` 和 `HumanMessage("[Tool returned]\n<content>")`。
- **关键点**：原始 `ToolMessage` 只存在于传入的状态 `messages` 里；`take_turn` 不返回任何结构化数值。因此操作数（`boll_ub`、`Close`、`Cost of Revenue`、`revenue`、`capex`、`Operating Cash Flow`）的自然接入点是 **ToolMessage 的 name 与 content**，而不是分析师报告的散文。这也意味着：FR-02 的输入适配必须从工具消息中**按字段提取**，而不能解析报告文本（后者也属于 out_of_scope 的“叙述算术”）。

**2. 分析师节点：`fundamentals_analyst.py`（已读）**
- 返回值固定为 `{"messages":[...], "fundamentals_report": report}`。这是 FR-02 在 fundamentals 侧**唯一**可挂载的窄缝；当前没有任何 `verified_metrics` 写入。

**3. 初始状态：`propagation.py`**
- `create_initial_state` 构造初始 dict，包含 `messages`、`company_of_interest`、`asset_type`、`instrument_context`、`trade_date`、`past_context`、`memory_note`、`portfolio_context`、两个 debate state 以及四个 `*_report` 空字符串。
- **注意**：`trade_date` 是字符串；`instrument_context` 是 run 开始时解析的确定性 ticker 身份字符串——而 `company_of_interest` 是原始 `company_name`。C0 要求记录的 `ticker` 是**规范化**的，`as_of_date` 是 ISO 格式。这里**没有** `run_id`、没有 `course_run`、没有 `verified_metrics`、也没有独立 `ticker` 字段，所以 C0 身份目前只能从 `instrument_context`/`company_of_interest` 推导，这不满足 C0 的字段级要求，是新增 state 键时需要与 integrator 冻结的点。

**4. 下游受控字段：`portfolio_manager.py`**
- 这是最终决策的生产者：结构化输出 `PortfolioDecision`（rating 来自 `decision.rating.value`），否则回退到自由文本并 `parse_rating`。

- 另有一个细节：本节点返回的是**整体替换** `risk_debate_state`，与 C0/C2 的“不要用并行节点重写整个共享嵌套字典”提醒相关，但目前它替换的是已有键，不是新指标键；不过新增键时仍要遵守窄集成原则。

- `_SECTIONS` 只渲染已有 `*_report` 字符串和 debate history；`_header` 用 `run_rating(final_state)`。没有任何指标表位置，需要新增一个确定性节。这属于共享文件，需要 integrator。

---

Baseline/HEAD：`3d5ce620e7da497e09c986ef6cbc957b490de632`（你已确认；我无法自证，未运行 Git）。契约：v1.0 C0/C2。状态：**提案，未批准**。

---

## 0. 证据分级（本计划的基础）

**A. 仓库内已有证据（可引用）**
- D1/D4 公式、阈值、容差、五个 ID：`requirements.yaml` L30–63；`verification-constraints.md` L11、L29–33、L46–57。
- AAPL 价差数值：D4 L53 加 SRC-07（`review-memo.md` L45），原始快照回包哈希 `fa8a4b65…`。
- AAPL Cost of Revenue 数值：D4 L52，但明确标为“reviewer-provided，原始年报回包待补”（SRC-06，L44）。
- 合成对照：D4 L32（100→125、20/80、10.125/5.599 反向）。**这是唯一仓库内可自足的算术样本。**
- MSFT 目标值 63.38%、NVDA 目标 105.85%：仅 D1 L41–42，**无操作数**。

**B. 你本轮提供的私有摘录（待 Liu 复核原件，未冻结）**

| 简称 | 内容 | 仓库状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `25d0d763` | 四案例个人来源表 v 版本 | 仓库**无此哈希登记** |
| `a7cf2857` | NVDA SEC 缓存；2025-04-28–2025-07-27 与 2026-04-27–2026-07-26 | 无；且**无当次逐工具回包** |
| `abe7f704` | AAPL 年度摘录（工具日志第 49 行） | 无；SRC-06 仍开放 |
| `2aace4c8` | MSFT 年度现金流摘录（第 62 行） | 无 |
| `ba7356fb` | AAPL 上轨/收盘摘录（第 80 行） | 数值在仓库，摘录本身无 |

**C. 尚待复核的真实案例**：NVDA、MSFT、AAPL 年度的**目标值**（105.85 / 63.38 / 10.98）在仓库里是**规格目标**，不是已通过结果。本计划要求它们先冻结为 fixture 并复核原件，在此之前 **不得记为 PASS**。

---

## 1. 拟读 / 拟改 / 新增路径

**拟读（本轮新增读取，全部精确路径，不列目录）**

| 路径 | 用途 | 权限 |

这些路径的**实际文件名**我不知道（禁止列目录），需要 Liu 给出准确路径后再批读。

**拟改（共享，需 Liu 统筹）**

| 路径 | 改动性质 |
|---|---|
| `tradingagents/agents/state.py` | 窄集成：新增独立键（名称见 §6 缺口 1） |
| `tradingagents/graph/propagation.py` | 初始化新键与 C0 身份（run_id/ticker/as_of_date） |
| `tradingagents/agents/analysts/fundamentals_analyst.py` | 只在返回 dict 增加一个键，不改报告逻辑 |

**新增（我自己的模块）**

| `test/offline/fixtures/fr02/`（确切文件名需 Liu 批准） | 合成 + 已冻结真实样本 |

**不改**：D1/D2、`.agent/rules.md`、`.opencode/*`、`tests/`、`cli/`、`AGENTS.md`、CI、Git。

---

## 2. 接入点（基于已读代码）

1. **操作数来源**：`turn.py` 的 `ToolMessage(name, content)` 是唯一原始数值载体；终轮被 `_as_text` 改写为文本。因此指标输入必须从 **ToolMessage 按字段提取**，**禁止**解析 `fundamentals_report` 散文（`product.yaml` out_of_scope）。
2. **注册表创建/保存**：在本次 run 内由 `verified_metrics` 创建；`metric_id` 只在同一 run 可解析；冲突写入拒绝；不改写既有记录。
3. **下游受控字段**：只持 `metric_id` 加只读摘要，通过 `resolve_metric` 解析；模型输出不能产生或覆盖数值。
4. **最终指标表**：`reporting.py` 新增节，遍历 registry 渲染 `metric_id / kind / operands / result / unit / period / source_ref`；UNVERIFIABLE 单列原因，不进指标值列。
5. **C0 身份**：`propagation.create_initial_state` 目前只有 `company_of_interest` 与 `instrument_context`，没有 `run_id`/`ticker`/`as_of_date`；需 Liu 决定扩展方式（§6 缺口 2）。

---

## 3. 五个测试 ID：输入 / 公式 / 预期 / 容差 / 失败行为 / 断言位置

断言位置约定：**U** = 单元（`test_offline/test_verified_metrics.py::<case>::<assert>`）；**S** = state 键；**R** = `reporting` 输出（tmp_path 下的 `complete_report.md` 文本）；**D** = 下游字段。

### T-FR02-YOY
- **输入**
  - 合成（必过，独立于真实数据）：prior=100、current=125，同期间同单位 → 25%。
  - 合成可比季：同季度相邻年，e.g. 2025Q1 vs 2026Q1。
  - 真实（待冻结）：AAPL `Cost of Revenue` current=245232 (FY2026) / prior=220960 (FY2025)，USD_millions，`abe7f704`。
  - 真实（待冻结）：NVDA `revenue` 96221（2026-04-27–2026-07-26）/ 46743（2025-04-28–2025-07-27），USD_millions，`a7cf2857`。
- **公式**：`100 * (current/prior - 1)`，Decimal 字符串输入，计算精度独立于显示。
- **预期**：25.0% / 10.9847936278…%（显示 10.98%）/ 105.85…%（按冻结操作数复算）。
- **容差**：|误差| ≤ **0.1 个百分点**（绝对，非相对）。
- **失败行为**：期间不可比、单位不同、分母 ≤ 0、非有限、缺来源 → `UNVERIFIABLE` + 原因码，**无** result_value。
- **断言**
  - U：结果在容差内；`result_unit == "%"`；operands 保留原始字符串精度。
  - U：期间不匹配/单位不匹配 → UNVERIFIABLE 且 reason 含对应码。
  - U：`prior=-5`、`prior=0` → UNVERIFIABLE（不抛 ZeroDivisionError 裸逃）。
  - S/R/D：同一 `metric_id` 出现在 state、报告指标表、下游字段。

### T-FR02-RATIO
- **输入**
  - 合成：同期间 numerator=20、denominator=80 → 25%。
  - 真实（待冻结）：MSFT capex=115948 / OCF=182935，USD_millions，FY2026，`2aace4c8`。
- **公式**：`100 * numerator / denominator`；记录量纲兼容与期间对齐。
- **预期**：25.0% / 63.38…%。
- **容差**：≤ 0.1 个百分点。
- **失败行为**：denominator ≤ 0、单位为比率/百分比而非 USD_millions、期间不对齐、非有限 → UNVERIFIABLE。
- **断言**
  - U：数值与容差。
  - U：`numerator=-100` → UNVERIFIABLE（**不得**自动取绝对值）。
  - U：denominator=0 → UNVERIFIABLE。
  - S/R/D：同一 ID 引用。

### T-FR02-DELTA
- **输入**
  - 合成：current=10.125、reference=5.599 → +4.526；反向 → −4.526。
  - 真实（待冻结）：`boll_ub=352.771`、`Close=348.245`，AAPL 2026-11-10，USD，`ba7356fb`。
- **公式**：`current - reference`，保留符号，`price_delta` 单位 USD。
- **预期**：+4.526 / −4.526；真实 +4.526 USD。
- **容差**：≤ **0.01 价格单位**。
- **失败行为**：单位不同、期间或快照日不一致 → UNVERIFIABLE；**绝不**做绝对值化。
- **断言**
  - U：正向 +4.526，反向 −4.526，**两向都断**（绝对值实现会让负向失败）。
  - U：`current` 与 `reference` 角色互换 → 符号翻转。
  - U：单位 USD vs USD_millions → UNVERIFIABLE。
  - S/R/D：同一 ID。

### T-FR02-INVALID
- **输入**：零/负分母；`NaN`、`Inf`、`-Inf`、`"nan"` 字符串；缺 `source_ref`；期间不可比（跨年 vs 季度）；单位不匹配；字段缺失。
- **公式**：不适用；应**在任何算术前**拒绝。
- **预期**：`MetricResult(status="UNVERIFIABLE", metric=None, reason_codes=[...])`；原因码可区分。
- **容差**：已验证字段内**零条**无效记录。
- **失败行为**：不得把无效值写入 registry、state 指标、报告表或下游字段；不得把 NaN 格式化进报告。
- **断言**
  - U：每个无效输入 → status 与 reason 精确断言。
  - U：`registry` 在 UNVERIFIABLE 后**不含**该 metric_id。
  - R：报告指标表不出现 NaN/Inf 数值行。
  - S：`state[verified_metrics]` 无无效条目。

### T-FR02-IDENTITY
- **输入**
  - 已注册的合法 metric（合成 100/125）。
  - 反例：未知 ID `"m-does-not-exist"`；已注册后**试图改值**；伪造构造一个新 `VerifiedMetric` 绕过 `verify_metric`；**跨运行** ID（run A 的 ID 在 run B 解析）。
- **公式**：`resolve_metric(metric_id, registry, run)` 只能返回 registry 内同 run 的原始记录。
- **预期**：合法 ID → 同一不可变记录；四种反例全部 `null` 或拒绝写入。
- **容差**：零容忍（数量比对）。
- **失败行为**：消费者自带值不生效；伪造记录不入 registry；跨 run 解析失败。
- **断言**
  - U：`resolve_metric(valid) is registry[valid]` 且 `result_value` 未被改动。
  - U：unknown → None；mutated copy → 拒绝（不可变/frozen 或写拒绝）。
  - U：`verify_metric` 第二次写同一 ID 不同值 → 冲突被拒。
  - U：新建 run B registry 解析 run A ID → None。
  - S/R/D：下游与报告用同一 ID，`result_value` 等于 registry 值。

---

## 4. 现有业务入口上的红灯（非“缺模块”）

**设计**：一条**合成 fixture** 走**已存在的 fundamentals 入口**：
1. 用 fake LLM + 固定 ToolMessage 序列喂给 `fundamentals_analyst_node`（`take_turn` 自然执行）。
2. 断言 `fundamentals_analyst_node` 返回的 dict 含一个可验证记录集合，且 `reporting.write_report_tree` 产出的 `complete_report.md` 含指标表。

**改业务代码前的预期红灯**：在 `test_verified_metrics.py::test_fr02_business_entry_metrics_reach_report` 中，断言 `"verified_metrics" in result` 或报告含指标表**失败**，因为 `fundamentals_analyst.py` L59–62 只返回 `messages`/`fundamentals_report`，`reporting.py` 无指标节。

**红灯合格条件**（严格）：
- 测试**已被收集并执行**，失败发生在**上述断言**；
- **不是** `ImportError`、`ModuleNotFoundError`、`fixture error`、`exit code 5`、零收集或缺模块；
- 若红灯表现为 “module not found”，按 Prompt.md 第 39 行处理：**不算**所需红灯，需 Liu 批准替代方式（先写可独立运行的单元断言，或先只建空 owner 文件再重跑）。

---

## 5. 顺序与人跑命令

**阶段 1｜写测试**（Build 角色，批准后）：只新增 `test/offline/test_verified_metrics.py` 与冻结 fixture。

**阶段 2｜人工验证红灯**（你执行）
```
python -m pytest --collect-only -q test/offline
python -m pytest -q test/offline/test_verified_metrics.py
```
要求：用例被收集；至少一个在业务入口断言处失败；记录失败断言与原因。

**阶段 3｜获准实现**：仅 `verified_metrics.py` 与共享文件窄补丁；共享文件须由 Liu 统筹合入。

**阶段 4｜复测**（你执行）
```
python -m pytest -q test/offline/test_verified_metrics.py
python -m pytest -q tests test/offline -m "not integration"
git diff --check
```

**阶段 5｜回滚**：`git revert` 本次提交或删新增文件；共享文件补丁单独恢复；测试与实现都不改 D1/D2；回滚后重跑阶段 4 的回归，确认基线无回归。

---

## 6. 需 Liu 单独决定的具体缺口（影响已标出）

1. **state 键名与类型**：是否沿用 `course_run` / `verified_metrics`；影响测试 S 断言与 integrator 合并。
2. **C0 身份来源**：`propagation` 是否新增 `run_id`/`ticker`/`as_of_date`；影响 `metric_id` 的 run 作用域与跨 run 反例。
3. **下游字段位置**：`portfolio_manager` 还是 reporting；影响 D 断言位置与是否改共享文件。
4. **指标表渲染格式**：节标题、是否显示 `metric_id`、是否展示 UNVERIFIABLE 原因；影响 R 断言字符串。
5. **fixture 文件名与存放目录**：`test/offline/fixtures/fr02/` 未批准；影响“来源可追溯”断言。
6. **真实样本冻结**：`a7cf2857`/`abe7f704`/`2aace4c8`/`ba7356fb` 与 `25d0d763` 需 Liu 复核原件后签发 fixture 版本号；未冻结前 YOY/RATIO/DELTA 的真实部分标 **BLOCKED**，不以仓库目标值冒充通过。
7. **工具文件确切路径**：§1 拟读表中三个工具文件真实文件名未知，需 Liu 提供后批读。

---

**本轮只做规划**：未改文件、未生成代码/测试、未运行命令、未重试被拒目录。上述真实案例的数字与摘录简称来自你的会话，需要 Liu 复核原件后再冻结；在此之前它们是**待复核输入**，不是通过证据。

48: def _tools_or_done(state) -> str:
49:     """Route an analyst's turn: run its tool calls, or finish with its report."""
50:     return "tools" if state["messages"][-1].tool_calls else END
51: 
52: 
53: def _analyst_graph(spec, agent, max_tool_rounds: int):
54:     """One analyst as a graph of its own: the model and its tools, on a private message history.
55: 
56:     It returns only its report, so analysts running side by side never write the
57:     same key, and its tool calls never reach the other analysts' messages. After
58:     ``max_tool_rounds`` rounds of tool calls it is told to write its report, and
59:     that turn ends it whatever it answers, so a model that keeps calling tools
60:     cannot run the graph into its recursion limit (#1420).
61:     """
62:     output = TypedDict(f"{spec.key.capitalize()}Report", {spec.report_key: str})
63:     graph = StateGraph(AgentState, output_schema=output)
64:     graph.add_node("agent", agent)
65:     graph.add_edge(START, "agent")
66:     if not spec.tools:
67:         graph.add_edge("agent", END)
68:         return graph.compile()
69: 
70:     def calls(messages):
71:         return [call["name"] for m in messages for call in (getattr(m, "tool_calls", None) or [])]
72: 
73:     def rounds(messages) -> int:
74:         return sum(1 for m in messages if getattr(m, "tool_calls", None))
75: 
76:     def more_or_wrap_up(state) -> str:
77:         return "wrap_up" if rounds(state["messages"]) >= max_tool_rounds else "agent"
78: 
79:     def wrap_up(state):
80:         repeated = ", ".join(f"{name} x{n}" for name, n in Counter(calls(state["messages"])).most_common())
81:         logger.warning("%s used its %d tool rounds (%s); asking for its report",
82:                        spec.agent_node, max_tool_rounds, repeated)
83:         return agent({**state, "messages": [*state["messages"], HumanMessage(WRAP_UP)]})
84: 
85:     graph.add_node("tools", ToolNode(list(spec.tools)))
86:     graph.add_node("wrap_up", wrap_up)
87:     graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", _tools_or_done, ["tools", END])
88:     graph.add_conditional_edges("tools", more_or_wrap_up, ["agent", "wrap_up"])
89:     graph.add_edge("wrap_up", END)
90:     return graph.compile()
91:

114:         Args:
115:             selected_analysts (list): List of analyst types to include. Options are:
116:                 - "market": Market analyst
117:                 - "social": Sentiment analyst
118:                 - "news": News analyst

122:         """
123:         plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analysts)
124: 
125:         analyst_factories = {
126:             "market": lambda: create_market_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),
127:             "social": lambda: create_sentiment_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),
128:             "news": lambda: create_news_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),
129:             "fundamentals": lambda: create_fundamentals_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),
130:         }
131: 
132:         bull_researcher_node = create_bull_researcher(self.quick_thinking_llm)
133:         bear_researcher_node = create_bear_researcher(self.quick_thinking_llm)
134:         research_manager_node = create_research_manager(self.deep_thinking_llm)
135:         trader_node = create_trader(self.quick_thinking_llm)
136: 
137:         aggressive_analyst = create_aggressive_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)
138:         neutral_analyst = create_neutral_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)
139:         conservative_analyst = create_conservative_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)
140:         portfolio_manager_node = create_portfolio_manager(self.deep_thinking_llm)
141: 
142:         workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)
143: 
144:         for spec in plan.specs:
145:             workflow.add_node(spec.agent_node,
146:                               _analyst_graph(spec, analyst_factories[spec.key](), self.max_tool_rounds))
147: 
148:         workflow.add_node("Bull Researcher", bull_researcher_node)
149:         workflow.add_node("Bear Researcher", bear_researcher_node)
150:         workflow.add_node("Research Manager", research_manager_node)
151:         workflow.add_node("Trader", trader_node)
152:         workflow.add_node("Aggressive Analyst", aggressive_analyst)
153:         workflow.add_node("Neutral Analyst", neutral_analyst)
154:         workflow.add_node("Conservative Analyst", conservative_analyst)
155:         workflow.add_node("Portfolio Manager", portfolio_manager_node)
156: 
157:         # The analysts work at the same time; the research debate starts once
158:         # every one of them has filed its report. The memory log settles past
159:         # decisions alongside them: only the Portfolio Manager reads its lessons.
160:         first_steps = [spec.agent_node for spec in plan.specs]
161:         if memory_node is not None:
162:             workflow.add_node("Memory Log", memory_node)
163:             first_steps.append("Memory Log")
164:         for node in first_steps:
165:             workflow.add_edge(START, node)
166:         workflow.add_edge(first_steps, "Bull Researcher")
167: 
168:         # Both research-debate edges share the complete DEBATE_PATH_MAP (#1088).
169:         for debate_node in ("Bull Researcher", "Bear Researcher"):
170:             workflow.add_conditional_edges(
171:                 debate_node,
172:                 self.conditional_logic.should_continue_debate,
173:                 DEBATE_PATH_MAP,
174:             )
175:         workflow.add_edge("Research Manager", "Trader")
176:         workflow.add_edge("Trader", "Aggressive Analyst")
177:         # All three risk edges share the complete RISK_ANALYSIS_PATH_MAP (#1088).
178:         for risk_node in ("Aggressive Analyst", "Conservative Analyst", "Neutral Analyst"):
179:             workflow.add_conditional_edges(
180:                 risk_node,
181:                 self.conditional_logic.should_continue_risk_analysis,
182:                 RISK_ANALYSIS_PATH_MAP,
183:             )
184: 
185:         workflow.add_edge("Portfolio Manager", END)

187:         return workflow

97:     to the report's header. ``html`` also writes ``complete_report.html``, one
98:     self-contained page of the same report (#1419).
99:     Reusing a directory replaces the generated report files, removing sections
100:     absent from this run and disabled HTML. Other files and directories are kept.
101:     """
102:     save_path = Path(save_path)
103:     save_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

105:     sections = []

108:         for _agent, filename, text in written:

110:         content = "\n\n".join(f"### {agent}\n{text}" for agent, _filename, text in written)
111:         sections.append(f"## {heading}\n\n{content}")

123:         (save_path / "complete_report.html").unlink(missing_ok=True)

127:     current_files = {
128:         (folder, filename)
129:         for _heading, folder, written in parts
130:         for _agent, filename, _text in written
131:     }
